title: A great clock!
text: A great clock!. I really like this clock and the fact that it dims way down.  I had bought another dimmer clock, but it was still very bright all the way turned down.  Buyers should be aware that it is lightweight, but I think for the price it's a great clock.

product_metadata.title: REACHER Kids Alarm Clock with USB Charger, Dimmable Rainbow LED Digital Display, Simple Basic Operation, Adjustable Volume, Small Plug in Clock for Bedroom, Bedside, Girls, Boys, Adults
features: Small Alarm Clock (5.6" x 2.9" x 1.9") with an extra USB port to charge your phone or other electronic devices. Easy to use. Even no need instructions to operate it.
Get your personal comfortable brightness with full range dimmer slider. Large colorful led numbers easy to read in a distance.
Adjustable alarm volume from 30-85db, wake up with a good mood.
Easy snooze with a simple press of anywhere on the top.
Outlet Powered: Come with 59in adapter, long enough to plug in socket. During power outage, 2* AAA batteries ( not included ) will memory time and alarm settings.
description: Easy to use and setup modern alarm clock; Use-friendly bedside alarm clock with compact size and colorful display fits for any decoration. Perfect for home, bedroom, hotel, office, nightstand, table, shelf. A great gift choice for Hallowmas, Christmas!
Adjust the brightness to what you desire with 0-100% dimmer switch. Easy to read in day, and not disturb your sleep at night.
Control alarm volume with slider from 30-85db, enjoy a fresh morning.
USB ports on the back panel, one for clock power supply, extra one for phones, tablets, or other electronics.

Plug-in to power the clock with the included USB adapter (100-240V). 2*AAA battery (not included) are just memory settings for time and alarm in case of power outage, during battery backup, the display goes blank and alarm won't sound.
1* alarm clock, 1* USB cable, 1*USB adapter, 1*User manual.
